title: A learning rubric makes untested skills visible
method: Synthetic five-dimension rubric, each 0–2: initial 2+1+0+1+0=4; later 2+2+2+1+1=8. Ordinal learning aid only; not a validated competence scale.
alt: A learning rubric makes untested skills visible: Initial evidence 4 rubric points, After practice 8 rubric points, Possible total 10 rubric points. Illustrative inputs.
